recentItems.title: Kerry Godliman Hosts Unconventional Monopoly Game | Menopause Monopoly | Channel 4
recentItems.description:
Kerry Godliman is hosting a games night with the girls, Fats Timbo and Anna Richardson. It’s a games night with a difference as they take on Menopause Monopoly, a bespoke version of the classic game created by Aviva. Inspired by the real experiences of those affected by the menopause across the UK, every roll of the dice, Chance & Pause card and property square on the board opens up an honest, funny and thought-provoking conversation about the menopause. 
 
Representing different stages of their menopausal journey; pre-menopausal, perimenopausal & postmenopausal, this trio of women bring their own experience, wisdom and questions to this unconventional games night as they explore everyday realities of menopause. The game is eye-opening and poses some home truths as each property square and card on the Monopoly board represents a real experience of the menopause journey. 
 
Menopause can affect every part of life and by empowering other women to speak about their own journey, the better supported women can be. Let’s break the silence. This conversation isn’t just for women going through menopause, it’s for anyone who wants to understand what it might mean for them and their close circle.
